The '''Quadrant Seven system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Barsa sector/Legends|Barsa sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quadrant Seven]].
